# Ability Check

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#AbilityCheck)*

An ability check is a [D20 Test](D20-Test.md) that represents using one of the six abilities—or a specific skill associated with an ability—to overcome a challenge. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[D20 Tests](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#D20Tests)" and "[Proficiency](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Proficiency)").
